The '''Kler'terria system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kler'terrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Questal" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kler'terria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" />
